summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting a change in control after Trafalgar Asset Management LLC, controlled by Porfirio Sanchez Talavera, purchased 100% of Series A and Series B preferred shares on June 29, 2026. This gave the buyer 96.62% aggregate voting power based on 994,379 common shares outstanding (Series A: 1.76 votes/share; Series B: 51% of all votes). Contemporaneously, certain company indebtedness was canceled via debt cancellation agreements. The buyer can now unilaterally elect directors and control shareholder votes. Watch for potential going-private steps or minority squeeze-out given the supermajority control.
